group.status: PB1 neutral vectors; data only; validated without loading either stack
group.note: The C7 and C10 vectors state the obligation each stack harness must discharge in PB4 and PB5. PB1 fixes what must be equal and what may differ; it does not execute the comparison.

when: Each declared Binding Plan fact is retrieved by name from the established binding
then: Every fact answers without invoking the provider
The values match what negotiation fixed
A compiled realization answers the same questions as an explicit-data realization

given: The plan assigned compact identifiers after canonical negotiation
when: The plan facts and the observation set are inspected
then: Both report canonical references, never compact identifiers
The assignments are recorded as plan data scoped to this binding

given: A request completed with a successful Outcome
then: Every normative field is present
The correlation mapping records a host-native Execution distinct from every Channel identity
Timing is recorded but drives no semantic decision

given: A local authority denial emitted no frame
then: Every normative field is still present
terminalStatus is denied, authorityDecisionPoint is host-local, and providerEffectCount and copyCount are zero
An unobservable value uses its declared absent form rather than being omitted

given: A payload was projected from command Shape version 2 to version 1
then: The projection appears as a mapping obligation
A representation mapping is distinguishable from a semantic translation, which would require an explicit Adapter Component

given: One fixed-direct-call realization and one negotiated-process realization of the same contract
when: Both execute the successful request vector
then: Every field in the parity profile is equal
Excluded fields differ only as their stated reasons permit

given: Both realizations of the same contract
then: Both report frameDecision none, resultClass denial, and zero provider effects
The no-frame decision is identical even though only one realization has a wire

given: A copied-immutable-blob resource in both realizations
then: copyCount is 1 across the process seam and 0 in the direct call
Parity still holds, because copy accounting is an excluded field with exactly this stated reason
flavor, ownership, integrityVerified, and accepted are equal

given: A provider endpoint that depends on neither stack
when: Each stack hosts it over the negotiated process realization
then: Both hosts establish, invoke, and observe the same category-level results
The contract is demonstrably implementable without importing either private model

given: Both stacks and the neutral artifacts
then: Neither stack references the other's assemblies, private types, codecs, or semantic runtime logic
The neutral layer contains no generated stack source and no runtime helper

given: Reference hosting Minimal, and Minimal hosting Reference
when: Both directions execute the same success and shaped-failure vectors
then: Both directions produce the same category-level observations
Neither direction depends on the other's private runtime
